g.data-flaw: BRINDLEWICK's letterspacing is now right but it is set in mixed case, Village runs into Fete, and the two-line white date is set tiny.
g.data-outlook: Fixable: the all-caps test missed the tracked title, and stacked lines need splitting apart.
